div.div: صَوْلَبٌ and ↓ صَوْلِيبٌ , (Lth, O, K, TA,) in some of the lexicons ↓ صَيْلِيبٌ , (TA,) Seed that is scattered (Lth, O, K, TA) upon the earth, (Lth, O, TA,) and upon which the earth is then turned with the plough: (Lth, O, K, TA:) Az thinks it to be not Arabic. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
